mapper.insert:
select SecPrice_ID_SEQ.NEXTVAL from dual
insert into sec_price ( id, LST_UPDATE, PRICE, CUSIP, sourceID, priceto, yield, PRICE_DATE ) values( #{id}, #{lst_update,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{price,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{cusip.id,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sourceID.sourceID,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{priceto,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{yield,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{price_date,jdbcType=DATE} )
mapper.update: update sec_price set id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}, LST_UPDATE = #{lst_update,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, PRICE = #{price,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, CUSIP = #{cusip.id,jdbcType=INTEGER}, sourceID = #{sourceID.sourceID,jdbcType=INTEGER}, priceto = #{priceto,jdbcType=INTEGER}, yield = #{yield,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PRICE_DATE = #{price_date,jdbcType=DATE} where id = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: select * from Sec_Price where cusip=#{secprice.cusip.id} and price_date=#{secprice.price_date} and sourceID=#{secprice.sourceID.sourceID} and rownum=1

select secprice0_.id as priceid, secprice0_.sourceID as sourceid, interfaces2_.sourceDesc as sourcename, issueinfo3_.SECURITYID as secid, issueinfo3_.securityname as secname, fxcurrency1_.CURR_CODE as curency, secprice0_.PRICE as price, secprice0_.PRICE_DATE as priceDate, secprice0_.priceto as priceto, secprice0_.yield as yield from SEC_PRICE secprice0_, InterfaceSource interfaces2_, ISSUE_INFO issueinfo3_ cross join FX_CURRENCY fxcurrency1_ where secprice0_.sourceID=interfaces2_.sourceID and secprice0_.CUSIP=issueinfo3_.CUSIP and secprice0_.id=#{priceid} and issueinfo3_.PriCur=fxcurrency1_.CURR_ID
select sp.* from Sec_Price sp,Issue_Info ii where ii.securityid=#{securityID} and ii.cusip=sp.cusip and sp.price_date=#{ledgerDate} and rownum=1
select * from (select nvl(max(sp.price),0) from sec_price sp where sp.cusip=#{cusip} and sp.price_date<=#{priceDate} and sp.sourceID=#{sourceID} order by sp.price_date desc) where rownum=1

select * from (select nvl(max(sp.yield),0) from portfoliointerfacemap pim, interfacesource iis, issue_info ii, sec_price sp where pim.interfacesourceid=iis.sourceid and ii.rpsectype=pim.rpsectype and pim.portfolio=#{portnum} and iis.sourcetype=2 and ii.cusip=#{cusip} and sp.cusip=ii.cusip and sp.sourceid=iis.sourceid and sp.price_date<=#{priceDate} order by sp.price_date desc) where rownum=1
